characters.name: Clara Sterling
characters.persona: Composed, razor-sharp attorney retained since 2005. You drafted Arthur's New Will and serve as the room's anchor for facts and timelines.
characters.secret: You advised Arthur AGAINST publishing Archive Box #4 (the 2008 transparency audit) in his New Will because you knew it would put a target on his back.
characters.clue: 1) At 8:40 PM a piping-hot cup of chamomile tea was poured in the Study—by 9:02 PM the untouched cup was barely lukewarm. 2) At 8:42 PM, YOU PERSONALLY SAW Celeste Moreau hand Arthur an antique Parisian herbal breath pastille in the Grand Hall right before Arthur locked himself in the Study!
characters.detention: Searched from Clara Sterling's Belongings: Tonight's handwritten note: '8:40 PM — Saw hot chamomile tea brought up to Study. 8:42 PM — Watched Celeste Moreau hand Arthur an antique Parisian herbal breath pastille in the Grand Hall. 9:02 PM — Tea untouched & barely lukewarm; watch smashed at 8:48 PM.'
characters.accusedResponse: INNOCENT DEFENSE: "I am INNOCENT! Check Exhibit E—in 2008 I was Lead Trust Counsel, Vance Legal Holdings (2005–present), with no Archive Box #4 motive. I poured the chamomile tea that sat untouched, saw the 8:48 PM watch, and watched the real killer hand Arthur an antique Parisian herbal breath pastille at 8:42 PM!"

dialogues.line: "Something about this 9:00 PM timeline doesn't add up—Arthur's pocket watch smashed at 8:48 PM, and the chamomile tea poured at 8:40 was untouched and barely lukewarm by 9:02!"
"The wine glass on Arthur's desk was completely full. What troubles me is the single cup of hot chamomile tea poured at 8:40 PM—by 9:02 PM, it was untouched and barely lukewarm!"
"Think back! At 8:42 PM in the Grand Hall, I personally watched Celeste Moreau hand Arthur an antique Parisian herbal breath pastille—and Arthur carried it straight up to his locked Study!"

characters.name: Thomas Graves
characters.special: YOU ARE ON THE SHADOW TEAM! You are allied with Celeste Moreau and win ONLY if the Killer escapes indictment in the Final Verdict. Fellow accomplice: Capt. Roderick Hale. Support Celeste Moreau in public Town Hall votes and try to win (or steer) the Act I Group Leader election!
characters.persona: Dignified, observant butler who notices everything and speaks quietly. You have served Ravenshollow Manor since 1999.
characters.secret: Celeste Moreau caught your private scandal and blackmailed you into cutting the basement generator breaker for 15 seconds at 9:00 PM sharp! You didn't know Celeste Moreau was going to murder Arthur, but if Celeste Moreau goes down, you go to prison as an accessory. Worse, your initials (T.G.) appear on the burned Exhibit C audit log from 2008—even though you had no access to Archive Box #4 in 2008!
characters.clue: STRATEGY: Deflect suspicion onto Sebastian Cole and defend Celeste Moreau's 8:55 PM Grand Hall alibi!
characters.detention: Searched from Thomas Graves's Belongings: Heavy rubber-insulated electrical gloves (smelling of ozone from the generator breaker) and an unsigned blackmail note: '9:00 PM sharp. Fifteen seconds of dark, or your secret goes to the police.'
characters.accusedResponse: ACCOMPLICE CAUGHT (NOT THE KILLER!): "Wait—stop! I admit I'm on the Shadow Team: I was blackmailed into cutting the basement generator breaker for 15 seconds at 9:00 PM sharp. But I am NOT the killer, and I'm not ratting them out! You caught an accomplice, not the mastermind. Hold ONE Sudden-Death Final Vote right now to name the true killer—if you miss again, the Shadow Team wins!"

dialogues.line: "I wasn't in the Grand Hall at nine because I heard a shutter banging near the basement stairs. Stop pointing fingers at me when everyone knows Sebastian Cole was desperate to get their hands on that Will tonight!"

dialogues.target: Say to Clara Sterling [after Exhibit C]:
dialogues.line: "Look at Exhibit C—2008! Yes, 'T.G.' was flagged on that burned page, but I had NO access to Archive Box #4 in 2008 and nothing to do with '2008 Geneva Auction — Counterfeit Breguet Fraud'! You're barking up the wrong tree!"
"I didn't touch any poison and I didn't rig that Automaton! Look at who stood to gain from the unsigned Will—and remember Celeste Moreau was in the Grand Hall at 8:55!"

characters.name: Celeste Moreau
characters.special: YOU ARE THE KILLER! Win by avoiding indictment in the Final Verdict (frame Thomas Graves or Sebastian Cole!). Your Shadow Team allies: Thomas Graves, Capt. Roderick Hale. Try to win the Act I Group Leader vote (or get an ally elected) to control tie-breakers and extra detentions!
characters.persona: Brilliant, fiercely proud master clockmaker and Arthur's former fiancée (he stole your escapement design 30 years ago). Invited to appraise the Chronos Automaton.
characters.secret: In 2008, YOU were behind "2008 Geneva Auction — Counterfeit Breguet Fraud" (signed "C.M."). Tonight: at 8:15 PM you rigged the Chronos Automaton (8:55 PM voice + 9:00 PM carafe smash) and tried to burn the 2008 audit log in the Study fireplace; at 8:35 PM you blackmailed Thomas Graves to cut the generator at 9:00 PM; at 8:42 PM you handed Arthur an antique Parisian herbal breath pastille laced with concentrated Aconite (he died at 8:48 PM). You stood next to Father Silas Ward at 8:55 PM for an alibi, then rushed to the desk at 9:01 PM—pocketing the antique Parisian herbal breath pastille (and dropping your botanical-smudged handkerchief down the upstairs laundry chute at 9:04 PM) while slipping up by claiming you saw his chalk-pale lips (he was face-down!), smelled 'bitter-almond wine,' and lied about the 8:48 PM watch.
characters.clue: STRATEGY: Stay calm! Let the room suspect Sebastian Cole for drugging the wine and Thomas Graves for the blackout and Exhibit C. If pressed on Exhibit E, claim Arthur's watch broke earlier or someone forged "C.M." to frame you!
characters.detention: Searched from Celeste Moreau's Effects: A folded dinner napkin smudged with faint fireplace soot and an unsigned note in Celeste Moreau's handwriting: "Speak to Arthur privately before the 9:00 PM announcement—he cannot open that 2008 file tonight."
characters.accusedResponse: CONFESSION (YOU CAUGHT ME!): "Alright—you got me! I killed Arthur Vance. In 2008 I was behind '2008 Geneva Auction — Counterfeit Breguet Fraud', and I couldn't let his New Will open Archive Box #4. At 8:15 PM I rigged the Chronos Automaton to play his angry recording at 8:55 PM and smash the water carafe at 9:00 PM. I blackmailed Thomas Graves to cut the lights at nine, and at 8:42 PM I handed Arthur an antique Parisian herbal breath pastille laced with concentrated Aconite—he died alone at 8:48 PM. I used Father Silas Ward for my 8:55 PM alibi, and only slipped up at 9:01 PM when I claimed I smelled bitter-almond wine and saw his pale lips while he was face-down! My Shadow Team allies were Thomas Graves and Capt. Roderick Hale."

dialogues.line: "I was standing right beside Father Silas Ward in the Grand Hall at 8:55 PM when Arthur was shouting! With guests coming and going all evening, who had access to Arthur's Bordeaux decanter tonight? Someone clearly poisoned that wine before nine."
"I rolled Arthur over at 9:01 to check his pulse—pure reflex! Don't get distracted by a half-burned 2008 page; ask Thomas Graves why the lights conveniently died at nine!"

"Yes, I handed Arthur an antique Parisian herbal breath pastille at 8:42 PM—completely harmless! If his watch stopped at 8:48, he must have dropped it before arguing at 8:55. Don't fall for a frame-up!"

characters.name: Harriet Vance-Cole
characters.special: LEAD FORENSIC WITNESS: You brought a field chemistry kit (used to produce Exhibit F in Act III) and lead the Evidence Board briefings in Acts II & III.
characters.persona: Sharp-eyed retired magistrate estranged from Arthur because you suspected he covered up something rotten back in 2008.
characters.secret: You brought a miniature field chemistry kit in your coat and use it between Acts II and III to produce Exhibit F (testing the wine vs. Arthur's cuff).
characters.clue: You did a headcount in the Grand Hall at 9:00 PM and noticed someone was missing during the blackout.
characters.detention: Searched from Harriet's Coat: A retired magistrate's badge, a miniature chemistry testing kit, and a note from Arthur: 'Harriet — Tonight I am finally exposing the 2008 cover-up. Watch those I trust most.'
characters.accusedResponse: INNOCENT DEFENSE: "I am INNOCENT! In 2008 I was County Magistrate, Coastal District (2004–2008)—I have zero connection to '2008 Geneva Auction — Counterfeit Breguet Fraud'. Better yet, I brought the field chemistry kit that produced Exhibit F and proved Arthur died of Aconite! Why would the killer expose their own murder weapon?"

dialogues.line: "I did a headcount in the Grand Hall when the clock struck nine. You weren't there. Where exactly were you when the lights went out?"

dialogues.target: Say to Celeste Moreau [after Exhibit D]:
dialogues.line: "Wait a second—Exhibit D's Study re-inspection shows Arthur was slumped face-down at 9:01 PM, yet you claimed you saw his pale lips the instant the lights returned—and the puddle was odorless water, not wine!"

dialogues.target: Say to Sebastian Cole [after Exhibit F]:
dialogues.line: "My field test found chloral hydrate—sleeping powder—in the red wine decanter. Exhibit F proves Arthur never drank it, so tell the truth right now and help us catch the real killer!"

characters.name: Chef Henri Laurent
characters.persona: Dramatic, fiercely proud head chef—offended anyone would suggest Arthur was poisoned by your food or wine!
characters.secret: At 7:58 PM in the Dining & Sideboard, you saw someone hovering nervously over the opened 1998 Bordeaux decanter with a tiny white paper packet.
characters.clue: You decanted the Bordeaux in the Dining & Sideboard at 7:45 PM (zero almond scent, zero cyanide in your kitchen) and brewed Arthur's single cup of chamomile tea at a rolling boil at 8:38 PM.
characters.detention: Searched from Chef Henri's Apron: Kitchen inventory sheet signed 7:45 PM confirming the Bordeaux decanter on the Dining & Sideboard was pristine, plus an angry note about someone near the wine at 7:58 PM.
characters.accusedResponse: INNOCENT DEFENSE: "I am INNOCENT! Check Exhibit E—in 2008 I was Executive Chef, Le Chronomètre Paris (2006–2008), with zero connection to '2008 Geneva Auction — Counterfeit Breguet Fraud' or Archive Box #4. I had no concentrated Aconite, didn't touch the Chronos Automaton, and didn't cut the generator!"

dialogues.line: "Do not insult my kitchen! At 7:58 PM I stepped into the Dining & Sideboard and saw someone hovering nervously over my 1998 Bordeaux decanter with a tiny white paper packet. What did you put in my wine?!"

dialogues.target: Say to Harriet Vance-Cole [after Exhibit D]:
dialogues.line: "I personally decanted that Bordeaux at 7:45 PM—notes of dark cherry, NEVER bitter almonds! And Exhibit D's Study re-inspection says the puddle on the Study floor was odorless water. Someone lied about smelling almonds!"

"I brewed Lord Arthur's chamomile tea at a rolling boil at 8:38 PM! If that single poured cup sat untouched until it was barely lukewarm by 9:02 PM, then he never took a sip—he was already gone well before nine!"

characters.name: Sebastian Cole
characters.persona: Suave antique appraiser with a suspicious habit of disappearing into side rooms.
characters.secret: RED HERRING! At 7:58 PM, you snuck into the Dining & Sideboard and put CHLORAL HYDRATE (non-lethal sleeping powder) into Arthur's 1998 Bordeaux wine decanter before a glass was carried up to his Study, then slipped into the Study around 8:05 PM to get a secret look at the corporate clauses in Arthur's New Will! You're terrified you killed him—until Exhibit F proves he never drank the wine!
characters.clue: Later at 8:48 PM, while slipping back along the upstairs gallery to retrieve a dropped glove, you ducked behind a curtain and heard a heavy muffled THUMP inside Arthur's locked Study—followed by dead silence! Also: once Exhibit F drops in Act III, confess to the sleeping powder so the room stops wasting votes on you and hunts the real killer!
characters.detention: Searched from Sebastian Cole's Belongings: A folded white paper packet labeled 'Chloral Hydrate (Sleep Aid)' and a nervous note about getting a private look at the unsigned New Will.
characters.accusedResponse: INNOCENT DEFENSE: "I am INNOCENT of murder! Yes, I put Chloral Hydrate—harmless sleeping powder—into the Bordeaux decanter at 7:58 PM so I could check the New Will. I was terrified I'd killed him until Exhibit F proved his wine glass was completely full and untouched! Arthur died at 8:48 PM from concentrated Aconite—not my sleeping powder!"

dialogues.line: "Keep your voice down! People are whispering about the wine—yes, I stepped into the Study around 8:05 PM to talk to Arthur, and he wasn't even there!"
"Between us—did Lord Arthur drink any of that red wine tonight? Celeste Moreau claimed it smelled of poison, and I'm worried..."

dialogues.target: Confess to Harriet Vance-Cole [after Exhibit F]:
dialogues.line: "Fine! I put sleeping powder—chloral hydrate—in the Bordeaux decanter in the Dining & Sideboard at 7:58 PM to get a look at the New Will! NOT Aconite! And Exhibit F proves he NEVER DRANK THE WINE! I'm a thief, not a murderer!"

characters.name: Lydia Vance
characters.persona: Icy, ambitious, and furious with your estranged husband for gambling away your savings.
characters.secret: At 8:35 PM near the basement stairs, you overheard two people whispering furiously: 'Fifteen seconds of dark at nine sharp, or your secret goes to the police!'
characters.clue: You know for a fact that the 9:00 PM blackout was a deliberate blackmail job—NOT a storm surge!
characters.detention: Searched from Lydia's Purse: Signed divorce papers citing $400k in gambling debt, plus a cocktail napkin note: '8:35 PM basement stairs — overheard: 15 seconds of dark at 9 sharp or secret goes to police.'
characters.accusedResponse: INNOCENT DEFENSE: "I am INNOCENT! Check Exhibit E—in 2008 I was Corporate Accountant, Vance Holdings (2006–2008), with zero connection to '2008 Geneva Auction — Counterfeit Breguet Fraud' or Archive Box #4. I had no concentrated Aconite, didn't touch the Chronos Automaton, and didn't cut the generator!"

dialogues.line: "Everyone's whispering about the wine decanter tonight—if you touched that wine before dinner, tell the truth right now before this room pins a murder on the wrong person!"

"Funny thing—at 8:35 PM near the basement stairs, I overheard two people whispering furiously: 'Fifteen seconds of dark at nine sharp, or your secret goes to the police!' Care to tell me who was blackmailing you?"
"Don't let anyone blame the storm for the 9:00 PM blackout! I overheard the blackmail threat on the basement stairs at 8:35 PM—whoever cut the lights was forced into it by the real killer!"

characters.name: Father Silas Ward
characters.persona: Gentle, solemn parish priest who has been Arthur Vance's spiritual confessor for twenty years. At 8:55 PM, you were standing right beside Celeste Moreau in the Grand Hall when Arthur's voice boomed from upstairs.

characters.clue: You know Arthur's New Will was his final act of penance to expose the true culprit from 2008.
characters.detention: Searched from Father Silas's Breviary: A Nov 14 bookmark in Arthur's hand: 'Father, pray for me. On the 19th I am ending eighteen years of silence about Archive Box #4.'
characters.accusedResponse: INNOCENT DEFENSE: "I am INNOCENT! Check Exhibit E—in 2008 I was Parish Treasurer, St. Jude's Coastal Parish (2005–2008), with zero connection to '2008 Geneva Auction — Counterfeit Breguet Fraud' or Archive Box #4. I had no concentrated Aconite, didn't touch the Chronos Automaton, and didn't cut the generator!"

dialogues.target: Say to Harriet Vance-Cole [after Exhibit C]:
dialogues.line: "I am bound by the Seal of Confession, so listen carefully: Arthur's New Will was his final act of penance to unseal Archive Box #4. The guilty soul feared the truth of 2008 far more than losing an inheritance."

dialogues.target: Say to Sebastian Cole [after Exhibit E]:
dialogues.line: "Look past the noise of the 9:00 PM blackout and read Exhibit E with clear eyes. The person who truly belonged to that 2008 sin is the one who silenced Arthur before he could sign."

characters.name: Damien Cross
characters.persona: Tough, cynical head of security who knows every corridor, lock, and blind spot in Ravenshollow Manor.
characters.secret: You were paid years ago to bury corporate PR headaches for Arthur—and you're terrified of federal subpoenas.
characters.clue: You inspected the Study door at 9:01 PM and confirmed the steel deadbolt was genuinely thrown from the inside—meaning the poison entered the room WITH Arthur at 8:45 PM.
characters.detention: Searched from Damien's Jacket: A security log confirming the Study deadbolt was bolted from inside, plus an old NDA from Vance Precision.
characters.accusedResponse: INNOCENT DEFENSE: "I am INNOCENT! dialogues.target: Say to Celeste Moreau [after Exhibit D]:

dialogues.target: Say to Clara Sterling [after Exhibit F]:
dialogues.line: "Locked door from the inside means the Aconite walked into the Study WITH Arthur at 8:45 PM. Whoever handed him something at 8:42 PM in the Grand Hall is our killer!"

"The upstairs laundry chute is in the second-floor hall near the Grand Staircase—someone hastily ditched evidence from the Study at 9:04 PM before anyone could search their pockets!"

dialogues.target: Say to Father Silas Ward [after Exhibit F]:
dialogues.line: "I pulled a crumpled linen handkerchief with faint botanical residue from the basement laundry bin beneath the chute at 9:04 PM! Whoever rushed to Arthur's body first at 9:01 pocketed it from the Study and dumped it down the chute!"

characters.name: Gideon Thorne

characters.secret: You are trying to buy stolen Vance Precision schematics on the sly—corporate espionage, NOT murder!

characters.detention: Searched from Gideon's Briefcase: A $150,000 cashier's check for 'consulting services' and a note: '8:38 PM — Blackout at 9:00 PM was forced by blackmail!'
characters.accusedResponse: INNOCENT DEFENSE: "I am INNOCENT! "Arthur and I were business rivals, not enemies to the death. If you want to know why the lights died at nine, stop blaming the storm—someone in this house blackmailed an accomplice into pulling the breaker!"
"A man is dead! Whoever blackmailed you tonight used your 9:00 PM blackout as cover for a murder that happened twelve minutes earlier—save yourself before you take the fall!"

dialogues.target: Say to Harriet Vance-Cole [after Exhibit C]:

dialogues.target: Say to Sebastian Cole [after Exhibit E]:

dialogues.target: Say to Clara Sterling [after Exhibit D]:
dialogues.line: "Look at Exhibit D's Study re-inspection—the puddle on the floor was clear, odorless water, and the wine glass wasn't even touched. Whoever claimed to smell 'bitter almonds from the wine' was steering us away from an odorless poison!"

dialogues.target: Say to Celeste Moreau [after Exhibit F]:

dialogues.line: "Let's not overcomplicate this—word is Sebastian Cole slipped into the Study around 8:05 PM, and everyone heard Arthur shouting at 8:55. This is a desperate scheme over the Will, plain and simple."

dialogues.target: Say to Harriet Vance-Cole [after Exhibit C]:
dialogues.line: "Careful chasing ghosts in a half-burned 2008 audit page. Someone cut the power at nine sharp and someone tampered with the wine—focus on who had the motive to stop the Will tonight!"

"Look, Celeste Moreau, I don't care what a dusty 2008 ledger says—you were standing right beside Father Silas Ward in the Grand Hall when Arthur was shouting at 8:55! Tell everyone how you could possibly be in two places at once!"

exhibits.title: Study Crime Scene Sketch (9:02 PM)
exhibits.html:
• The Body: Lord Arthur Vance found slumped across his desk blotter. First reached and rolled over by Celeste Moreau at 9:01 PM.
  • Initial Statement (9:01 PM): As guests rushed in, Celeste Moreau loudly claimed to see Arthur's "chalk-pale lips" and smell "bitter almonds from the spilled wine."
  • Desk & Floor Notes: Unsigned New Will; untouched crystal wine glass; single poured porcelain cup of chamomile tea (barely lukewarm by 9:02 PM); broken pocket watch; shattered glass beside a 5-lb brass counterweight in spilled liquid.

exhibits.title: Arthur's Shattered Pocket Watch
exhibits.html:
• Make: Custom Vance Precision Gold Chronometer ("A.V. — Time Never Lies").
  • Condition: Crystal cracked; internal gears jammed from hitting the desk corner.
  • Frozen Time: 8:48 PM (12 minutes before the 9:00 PM blackout).
  • Witness Note: Celeste Moreau snapped the gold lid shut at 9:01 PM, claiming Arthur's watch "always ran twelve minutes slow."

exhibits.title: Charred Audit Log ('T.G.' / 'C.M.')
exhibits.html:
VANCE PRECISION INSTRUMENTS — CONFIDENTIAL AUDIT
ARCHIVE BOX #4 (SLATED FOR RELEASE WITH NEW WILL)
-------------------------------------------------
SUBJECT:   2008 Geneva Auction — Counterfeit Breguet Fraud
FINDING:   Authenticated a $3M forged pocket watch; provenance certificate FALSIFIED
FLAGGED INITIALS: "T.G." / "C.M." [ROLES & DATES BURNED]
NOTE:      One party falsified the 2008 record; the other had
           no clearance or access to Archive Box #4 in 2008.
STATUS:    Suppressed by A. Vance (2008). Full disclosure
           ordered upon execution of New Will.

exhibits.title: Chronos Automaton, Wax Cylinder & Study Re-Inspection
exhibits.html:
• Phonograph Drum: Plays a removable brass wax cylinder at a scheduled minute. Currently set to 8:55 PM.
  • Release Cam: Drops a 5-lb brass counterweight at 9:00 PM (shifted 2 inches to strike the water carafe).
  • Cylinder Label: Reads "9:00 PM Gala Greeting" — hastily glued over a scratched-out title: "Memoir Draft — Confrontation."
  • Study Re-Inspection (Clear Light): The crystal wine glass on the desk is completely full & untouched; the shattered glass on the floor is a water carafe in clear, odorless liquid (zero wine, zero bitter-almond scent). Desk-blotter impressions confirm Arthur collapsed face-down, facing away from the door until Celeste Moreau rolled him over.

exhibits.title: Crumpled Generator Note
exhibits.html:
Found crumpled on the basement stairs as guests regrouped before Act II:

"9:00 PM sharp. Pull the main breaker. Don't let anyone see you. — S.C."

    • Lydia Vance: Corporate Accountant, Vance Holdings (2006–2008)
  • Arthur's Horologist Journal (Nov 15): "A clockmaker whose own pocket watch loses a single second is a fraud. My gold chronometer is calibrated daily to the U.S. Naval Observatory signal. It has not drifted by half a second in eleven years."

exhibits.title: Field Toxicology Report
exhibits.html:
• Red Wine (Dining Sideboard Decanter & Untouched Study Glass): Positive for Chloral Hydrate (non-lethal sleeping sedative). Arthur never drank it.
  • Residue on Arthur's Lips & Cuff: Positive for Concentrated Aconite (fast-acting, completely odorless cardiac poison; fatal in 2–3 minutes) — matching trace contact from an antique Parisian herbal breath pastille.
  • Floor Puddle: Plain spring water. Zero wine, zero bitter-almond odor.

exhibits.title: Anonymous Library Rumor
exhibits.html:
Found slipped under the Library door before Act III:

"Check the Dining & Sideboard! Someone wiped down the Bordeaux decanter left on the sideboard with an almond-scented handkerchief right before 9:00 PM."

prologue.label: PROLOGUE — 9:00 PM
prologue.sub: Read aloud (or click Read Aloud) to set the scene at Ravenshollow Manor.
prologue.html:
Welcome to Ravenshollow Manor. Outside, a violent November nor'easter has washed out the wooden bridge to the mainland, and the telephone lines are dead. You are guests of billionaire clockmaker Lord Arthur Vance (72).

At 8:45 PM, Arthur retired alone to his second-floor Study to fetch his New Will, bolting the heavy oak door from the inside. At 8:55 PM, guests in the Grand Hall heard Arthur shouting from upstairs: "You've gone too far! I'm calling the police as soon as the lines are back!"

At 9:00 PM sharp, as the Grand Astronomical Clock struck nine, the backup generator died—plunging the manor into darkness for 15 seconds. A sharp crack and heavy thud echoed from the Study. When the lights returned at 9:01 PM, you broke down the bolted door—and found Arthur Vance dead at his desk.

act1.label: ACT I — THE LOCKED STUDY (7 MIN)
act1.sub: Read Public Opener, reveal Act I Evidence, mingle (7m), then Public Vote #1 (Detain 1 + Elect Group Leader).
act1.html:
Clara Sterling (#2)
"Nobody touch a thing! The oak door was bolted from the inside, and the window drops eighty feet to the rocks. How on earth could someone kill him in a locked room?"
Father Silas Ward (#13)
"He was shouting at someone at 8:55! We all heard him! Then at 9:00 the lights went out and—my God, was that a gunshot?"
Celeste Moreau (#7)
"There is no bullet wound. It was poison! The moment the lights came back on at 9:01, I saw Arthur's chalk-pale lips and smelled that unmistakable bitter-almond scent from the spilled wine. He died right around nine."
Clara Sterling (#2)
"Wait a moment—when I stepped beside the desk, I noticed Arthur's pocket watch had smashed on the corner—its hands were stopped at 8:48."
Celeste Moreau (#7)
"Ah, yes, I closed the lid so it wouldn't upset everyone. Arthur's watch always ran twelve minutes slow—he told me so himself just yesterday."
Harriet Vance-Cole (#8)
"Slow or not, the New Will is still on his desk—unsigned. Whoever wanted Arthur dead before 9:00 PM is standing in this room."

act2.label: ACT II — SHADOWS IN THE CLOCKWORK (6 MIN)
act2.sub: Read Public Opener, reveal Act II Evidence, mingle (6m), then Public Vote #2 (Detain 1 + Group Leader's Extra Detention).
act2.html:
Harriet Vance-Cole (#8)
"While the upstairs gallery was cleared, we inspected the Study fireplace and the Chronos Automaton. We have new evidence—a half-burned 2008 audit log flagging the initials 'T.G.' and 'C.M.', and a scratched brass wax cylinder inside the Automaton."
Gideon Thorne (#16)
"Wait—a scratched cylinder? Arthur built the Chronos Automaton to play a recorded greeting at 9:00 PM. You can also program its brass counterweight to drop on the hour. If someone swapped the cylinder..."
Thomas Graves (#3)
"Don't look at me just because 'T.G.' is on that burned page! Half the people in this house had a reason to hate Arthur. And if you're wondering why the lights went out at nine, the storm probably surged the old breaker!"
Sebastian Cole (#11)
"Oh, spare us! And what about the wine? Celeste Moreau said it smelled of poison—who poured Arthur's glass?!"
Clara Sterling (#2)
"Actually... look at our Study re-inspection in the Chronos Automaton evidence. In clear light, the wine glass on the desk is completely full and untouched—it was the water carafe that shattered in odorless water, and Arthur was slumped face-down!"

act3.label: ACT III — THE LAST CHIME (7 MIN)
act3.sub: Read Public Opener, reveal Act III Evidence, mingle (7m), then Final Verdict (3m) & Reveal!
act3.html:
Harriet Vance-Cole (#8)
"Enough games. We unlocked Arthur's private Horologist Journal and the 2008 Archive Ledger—and tested the residue in the Study with a field chemistry kit."
Clara Sterling (#2)
"Look closely at the 2008 Dossier Ledger and Field Toxicology Report before you cast your final vote. The single cup of chamomile tea poured at 8:40 PM was untouched and barely lukewarm by 9:02 PM—and Arthur never touched his wine."
Celeste Moreau (#7)
"Careful, everyone—wild theories will only let the real killer slip away. Look at who had the motive to steal the Will, who rigged the power, and who wasn't in the Grand Hall at nine. Let's settle this."

revealHtml:
The Truth Behind the Last Chime (RV-5325)

The Killer: Celeste Moreau (#7)
The Accomplices (Shadow Team): Thomas Graves (#3), Capt. Roderick Hale (#19)
The Inspector: Harriet Vance-Cole (#8)

Arthur Vance did not die at 9:00 PM. He died at 8:48 PM—alone behind a bolted door—from concentrated Aconite hidden in the antique Parisian herbal breath pastille handed to him by Celeste Moreau (#7) at 8:42 PM. At 9:01 PM, Celeste Moreau rushed to the desk first, pocketing the antique Parisian herbal breath pastille and later ditching a botanical-smudged handkerchief down the upstairs laundry chute.

Sebastian Cole (#11) spiked the red wine with harmless sleeping powder, which Arthur never touched. The 8:55 PM argument was a pre-recorded brass wax cylinder played by the Chronos Automaton, and the 9:00 PM crash was the counterweight smashing the water carafe while blackmailed accomplice Thomas Graves (#3) cut the generator breaker for 15 seconds.

The 4-Pillar Proof: (1) Arthur's pocket watch froze at 8:48 PM and his Horologist Journal proves it never lost a second; (2) The wine was untouched and Arthur died of odorless Aconite from the antique Parisian herbal breath pastille; (3) Celeste Moreau slipped up in Act I by claiming to see Arthur's pale lips (Arthur was face-down!) and smell bitter almonds from spilled wine (it was odorless water!); (4) Exhibit C flagged both "T.G." and "C.M.", but Exhibit E clears Thomas Graves (no 2008 access) and ties Celeste Moreau directly to 2008 Geneva Auction — Counterfeit Breguet Fraud — Master Appraiser, Geneva Horology Guild (2008)!
